decisions.reason: The conversion-over-aesthetics priority is an overall creative objective and does not replace or invalidate the candidate's specific reference strategy, originality, or narrative instructions.
The existing direct, attention-focused hook requirement remains valid unchanged; the source adds a separate overall conversion objective without changing the hook's specified approach.

The source does not resolve or modify the outstanding choice between actual footage and realistic AI-generated scenes; prioritizing conversion over aesthetics does not determine the production method.
The source does not alter the required reference keywords, preserved message, or non-generic wording; those specific messaging constraints remain valid under the separate conversion objective.
The conversion-performance priority neither changes the requested audio specification nor resolves its existing ambiguity.
The source does not change the number, duration, commissioning stage, or conditional ordering of the video deliverables.
